title: Landsat-8 Operational Land Imager Design, Characterization and Performance
lineage: Publisher or operator text. Local file preserves selected passages and research notes.

passages.note: Instrument-team paper describes ALI's pushbroom demonstration and its focal-plane modules as the starting point for OLI modules. Ball developed OLI under its NASA Goddard contract.

passages.note: Discusses Landsat continuity and OLI's different design for visible, near-infrared and short-wave infrared measurements. TIRS is a separate instrument.
